parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: set to 'request' to get a list of all time off types with which this user can create a time off request. The default is to return the list of time off types the user has permissions on. This distinction is important, as employees can request time off for types that they don't have permission to view balances and requests for.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A particular request ID to limit the response to.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Limit to requests that the user has a particular level of access to. Legal values are: "view" or "approve". Defaults to view.

parameters.name: employeeId
parameters.description: A particular employee ID to limit the response to.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Only show time off that occurs on/after the specified start date.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Only show time off that occurs on/before the specified end date.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: A comma separated list of time off types IDs to include limit the response to. If omitted, requests of all types are included.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: A comma separated list of request status values to include. If omitted, requests of all status values are included. Legal values are "approved", "denied", "superceded", "requested", "canceled".
